_about: Suppression entries the Instantly workspace cannot tell the factory about. Everything else (leads already in the workspace, bounces, unsubscribes, blocklist, hostile replies, contacted domains) is pulled read-only at run time. Edit this file by hand; the factory never writes it.
client_domains_note: Lorenzo's own sending domains. Add every paying client's domain here on the day they sign: a live client receiving a cold pitch from us is the one suppression failure that costs revenue rather than reputation.
manual_domains_note: Free mailbox providers. A personal address is never a company contact, and pattern-guessing against gmail.com produces garbage that burns verification credits. These are matched as domains, so a lead whose only address is a gmail one is rejected before it costs anything.
